description: Instant text & keyword search across page text, labels, and placeholders. Returns matched element coordinates, selectors, and ref IDs.

all.description: Set true to return all matching elements on the page (default false returns first match).

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

limit.description: Max number of matches to return when all: true (default 10).

query.description: Text or keyword query to search for on the page.

name: browser_find
